evidence.quote: We install humidity sensors in all four greenhouse bays before the first frost.

observations.why: Operational directive setting a concrete, binding timeline and scope for action.

evidence.quote: Bay two gets the pilot unit first

observations.why: Establishes operational sequencing as a settled rollout decision.
Explicit verbal ratification confirming and closing the decision.

evidence.quote: The sensors report every fifteen minutes; anything slower misses the overnight drop.

observations.why: Sets a hard operational reporting parameter grounded in a non-negotiable functional requirement.
